title: Grateful Dead Live at University Of Iowa Fieldhouse on 1982-08-10

ai_review.summary: A flawless matrix recording captures a 1982 monster show, highlighted by an epic second set (China > Rider, Lost Sailor > Saint) and soaring performances.
ai_review.review: The matrix blend of audience and soundboard sources is praised as seamless and crystal‑clear, delivering every instrument with excellent definition.  The concert itself “smokes” from start to finish – the band is tight, energetic, and delivers standout moments such as China > Rider, Lost Sailor into Saint, and a ripping Jerry Garcia throughout.  While one reviewer disliked the matrix mix, the overwhelming consensus is that both the music and the recording are top‑tier.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating ≈ 4.5 from eleven reviews, with consistent high praise for both performance and matrix sound quality; only a single dissenting comment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Seamless blend of audience (AUD) and soundboard (SBD), crisp clarity, all instruments audible. Minor notes about speed correction and one reviewer feeling the matrix dulled the audience mix, but overall regarded as superb.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong pacing with a silky first set and an explosive second set; transitions (e.g., China into Rider) are praised for their flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for powerful vocals, magical phrasing, and extended solos that drive the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as “raging” and a solid presence throughout, with notable pre‑encore comment and strong bass foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for enthusiastic banter, memorable slide solo in Minglewood, and energetic rhythm guitar work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s B3 organ and electric piano are celebrated as outstanding, providing superb vocal harmonies and texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart receive praise for driving the band and delivering an amazing rhythmic backbone.
